settings.label: 空间地址
settings.hint: 在空间里打开任意页面，复制浏览器地址栏的地址。飞书项目和 Meegle（Lark）都支持，按域名区分。修改后需要重新登录。

en.label: Space URL
en.hint: Open any page in the space and copy the address. Works for both Feishu Project and Meegle (Lark). Changing it signs you out.

settings.label: 工作项类型
settings.hint: 工作项类型的 key，逗号分隔。默认是需求（story）和缺陷（issue）；填错时同步会列出空间里可用的类型。

en.label: Work item types
en.hint: Comma-separated type keys. Defaults to stories (story) and issues (issue); a wrong key makes the sync list the space's types.

settings.label: 筛选条件（MQL）
settings.hint: 只写 WHERE 后面的条件，按字段 key 书写。默认是我参与的工作项；当前负责人是我：array_contains(`current_status_operator`, current_login_user())；我创建的：`owner` = current_login_user()。

en.label: Filter (MQL)
en.hint: Only the condition after WHERE, written with field keys. Defaults to items I take part in. Currently mine: array_contains(`current_status_operator`, current_login_user()); created by me: `owner` = current_login_user().
